summary: Scott M. Bahley supports the draft environmental statement's effort to restrict off-road vehicle use on public lands, viewing it as a good first step toward returning forested areas to the majority of the population who explore public lands without mechanical vehicles. He emphasizes that effective enforcement and prosecution of violators is the crux of the matter, noting concerns about snowmobiles and motorcycle groups threatening other users on trails. He appears to favor stronger action against ORV use going forward.
